name: ML–Based Adaptive Noise Cancellation for Real-Time VLSI Systems
description:
Noise characteristics, SNR metrics, and classical adaptive filtering (LMS, NLMS, RLS).
DSP foundations for real-time ANC: FIR/IIR structures, latency, and stability.
Limitations of traditional adaptive filters in non-stationary noise environments.
ML formulations for noise cancellation: regression, online learning, and inference.
Neural network models for ANC: MLP, CNN, RNN, and lightweight temporal models.
Streaming and online adaptation techniques for real-time signal processing.
Fixed-point arithmetic, quantization, and precision optimization for ML models.
VLSI architectures for ML-based ANC: pipelining, parallelism, and memory design.
HDL/HLS implementation and FPGA/ASIC realization of ANC systems.
Low-power design, verification, and real-time performance benchmarking.
